precision_at_budget_bootstrap.note: the flag budget is rescaled to each replicate's own size, so a replicate that draws fewer rows flags proportionally fewer of them

verdict.rule: ADMITTED if AUROC >= 0.75 for intent error with cluster-bootstrap CI90 lower bound >= 0.7, OR if precision at 86 flags exceeds the schema judge's 72.09 % with CI90 lower bound above it; otherwise NOT ADMITTED and the re-ask module falls back to the deterministic judges
